title: Infinitely Divisible Distributions and Lévy-Khintchine Theorem (OQ-03-OQ-02)
description: Formalizes infinitely divisible probability distributions and the Lévy-Khintchine theorem. Proves: convolution power distributes over products, δ₀ is infinitely divisible, ID closed under convolution and convPow. Axiomatizes Gaussian as ID and the full Lévy-Khintchine classification (requires characteristic functions). 11 axioms. 13 theorems.

overview.historicalContext: Lévy-Khintchine theorem classifies all infinitely divisible distributions via (b, σ², ν): drift + diffusion + Lévy jump measure.
overview.problemStatement: Formalize infinitely divisible distributions and prove basic properties.
overview.proofStrategy: Define convolution monoid on measures; prove convPow_dist; define IsInfDivisible; prove closure properties; axiomatize Lévy-Khintchine.
